title: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU)
summary: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) is a university in Cleveland. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with CWRU.

sections.heading: What CWRU is known for
paragraphs: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) is a private nonprofit institution known for its diverse academic offerings and research initiatives. With an undergraduate enrollment of 6,437 students, the university maintains a selective admission rate of approximately 36.54%. CWRU is recognized for its strong programs in health and business, which constitute about 7.8% and 7.6% of the total academic programs, respectively. These areas highlight the university's commitment to preparing students for careers in critical and evolving fields. As a private nonprofit university, CWRU emphasizes both academic excellence and research innovation.

sections.heading: How to read CWRU tuition
paragraphs: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) charges a tuition fee of $66,608 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition rate applies regardless of residency status. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, housing, meals, and other personal costs, amounts to $85,851. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families anticipate the financial commitment required for enrollment at CWRU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) offers financial aid to support students in managing the cost of attendance. Approximately 17.52% of undergraduates receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies aimed at students with financial need. Among students who complete their degrees, the median debt incurred is $24,000. Prospective students and families can explore detailed financial aid information and use the net price calculator available on CWRU's official website at www.case.edu/. Additional data on costs and aid can also be found through the U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard at https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/school/?201645.

paragraphs: Career outcomes for graduates of Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) indicate a strong completion rate, with approximately 87.17% of students finishing their programs within 150% of the expected time. Among students who complete their degrees, the median debt incurred is around $24,000.
